subject: Tree of Mana
text: The Tree of Mana grows high above the clouds on top of Mount Illusia.

evidence.quote:
It grows high above the clouds in the air
on top of Mount Illusia.

subject: Directional Pad
text: The directional pad moves the character in four directions (up, down, left, and right) without diagonal movement, and moves the menu cursor.

evidence.quote:
The directional pad allows you to move your character on the screen.
Your character can be moved in only four directions, up, down, left,
and right, but not diagonal. The directional pad can also move the
cursor on the menu screen.

subject: A Button
text: The A button attacks with the equipped weapon on the World Screen and executes selected commands on the Menu Screen.

evidence.quote:
- On the World Screen, the A button can be used to make your character
attack with the weapon he has equipped.
- On the Menu Screen, the A button is used to execute the command that
you have selected.

subject: B Button
text: The B button uses equipped Magic or Items on the World Screen and cancels selected commands or exits menus on the Menu Screen.

evidence.quote:
- On the World Screen, the B button can be used to use Magic or an Item
that you are equipped with.
- On the Menu Screen, the B button can be used to cancel a command that
has been selected or to exit a menu screen.

subject: Start Button
text: The Start button opens the menu for Item, Magic, Equip, and Ask commands, displaying equipped gear and character condition.

evidence.quote:
The Start button opens the screen for Item/Magic/Equip/Ask commands,
the weapon and magic your character is currently equipped with, and
your character's condition.

subject: Select Button
text: The Select button opens the screen for Save, Map, and Status commands.

evidence.quote: The Select button opens the screen for Save/Map/Status commands.
